thread:
meera: FYI NVD published CVE-2026-1457 — active exploit against fast-serializer v2.1.8. PoC posted this morning. Affects deserialization path for ingestion API. https://gist.github.com/redwood/poC-1457
ryan: @sec-oncall can you confirm whether prod services load fast-serializer at runtime?
sec-oncall: Confirmed. app-ingest, stream-worker, and batch-hydrator use the lib. We've seen stack traces in eu-prod cluster at 08:12 UTC matching the PoC pattern.
meera: Ok. Triage notes: severity -> high. Likelihood of remote exploitation: high for public ingestion endpoints. Immediate mitigations: 1) block public ingestion endpoint via edge ACL, 2) enable stricter RBAC on service tokens, 3) prepare emergency patch.
drianna: Edge ACL — I can flip the rule for eu and us-east. Will need the exact path.
miguel: I'll take patch build and canary in eu-canary. Plan: bump fast-serializer to 2.1.10 (fix landed upstream), build image with tag service/ingest:patch-1457, deploy to one canary host. ETA ~18m.
olivia: Note: worker processes read KMS-wrapped keys at startup. If we restart processes to pick up the patch, KMS client will re-request keys. That should be fine; no key rotation necessary for this fix.
alice: RBAC change: adding new role ingest_writer_strict. Pushing Vault policy now. Will attach policy to service tokens for ingest services only.
ryan: For audit logging — enable deserialization failure logs and forward to sec-logs. meera, can you list the log filters we should apply?
meera: Add filter: "java\.lang\.RuntimeException: deserialize.*fast-serializer" and any stack frames containing com.fastser. Also add a metric for frequency.
secbot: [incident created] incident-2026-05-19-CVE-1457 | severity: high | owner: meera | channel: #incidents-1457
meera: Comms: draft internal blurb, outward-facing customer note only if we confirm exploit scope. No PII confirmed. Security advisory template in #security-ops will be filled.
ryan: Quick question — if we rotate KMS keys during rollout, do we need to rewrap persisted tokens?
olivia: Not strictly required. Existing wrapped keys still decrypt with old key until rotation cutoff. We'll schedule a rewrap background job after stabilization, not as emergency step.
devon: Any DB schema or data migration that could break during restart?
miguel: No DB work planned. Only binary bump + restart. We'll use graceful drain to avoid inflight requests.
drianna: Edge ACL updated: blocked /v1/ingest/public on eu/us-east. :white_check_mark:
meera: Deploy steps (short):
```
git checkout -b hotfix/cve-1457
# bump dependency in build.gradle to 2.1.10
./ci/build -t ingest:patch-1457 && ./deploy --env=eu-canary --image=ingest:patch-1457
```
miguel: Canary deployed to eu-canary (instance i-0abc123). Health checks green. Observability: increased deserial errors on canary initially then dropped to zero after patch.
meera: After canary success, rollout to us-east and global. Set rollout window 5 minutes per pool with automatic rollback on 5xx spike.
alice: RBAC policy applied. Service tokens reissued for canary only. Make sure secrets rotation dashboard shows no failures.
ryan: Added CloudWatch filter and KQL rule in sec-logs. Alert if deserialize error rate > 10/min for any cluster.
sec-oncall: We're keeping ingestion public block in place until global rollout completes.
meera: Post-action items: backport to 2.4.x, publish advisory, run key rewrap migration, do a security review of other deserializers. Owners: meera, ryan, olivia.
secbot: :eyes: tagging compliance for audit trail retention adjustments.
meera: I'll draft the postmortem and timeline. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
